decision: Can one small shared current-root/action model trained directly by h16 physical-HIT Brier learn a bounded probability surface that improves on the frozen L2 ridge, retains an increment over the same architecture without action-relative facts, and generalizes to randomized nonbaseline behavior on reused L2d episodes?

evaluation.use: single post-selection evaluation on already observed L2d episodes; may select fresh confirmation but is not independent evidence

gate.direct_model_gain: complete-episode bootstrap upper endpoint for direct full minus frozen L2 full Brier is below zero
gate.incremental_action_signal: complete-episode bootstrap upper endpoint for direct full minus same-architecture state-only Brier is below zero with at least six of eight favorable episode directions
gate.nonbaseline_action_signal: known-nonbaseline rows occur in all eight episodes, meet positive support, have bootstrap upper endpoint below zero, and at least five favorable episode directions
gate.prefirst_hit_lifecycle: pre-first-HIT rows occur in all eight episodes, meet positive support, have bootstrap upper endpoint below zero, and at least six favorable episode directions

hypotheses.H1_direct_probability_model: If L2/L2e failed because linear probability plus post-hoc scalar calibration is the wrong conditional surface, a fixed small nonlinear action-conditioned regressor trained directly by Brier will beat the frozen L2 full ridge under a complete-episode bootstrap.
hypotheses.H2_action_increment: If current-root action-relative facts contain stable risk information rather than state-only route context, the full direct model will beat an otherwise identical state-only regressor overall and on known-nonbaseline rows.
hypotheses.H3_lifecycle: The full-versus-state increment remains before the first physical HIT, so any selected model is not supported only by post-HIT lifecycle state.
hypotheses.H4_probability_surface: The direct model remains almost entirely inside [0,1] before clipping and passes the unchanged L2d calibration-in-the-large and ECE-relative limits.
hypotheses.H5_selection_limit: All L2d episodes and prior comparator results have already been inspected. Passing may select this immutable model for wholly fresh confirmation only; it cannot independently confirm, establish causal action value, promote a policy, or authorize value learning.

non_goals: no behavior cloning, collector imitation, scalar calibration, temperature, isotonic, beta, spline, binning, architecture sweep, optimizer sweep, or threshold sweep
no new Wine episode, corpus mutation, target, horizon, history, object encoder, recurrent state, critic, actor, RL, IQL, CQL, OPE, active collection, or counterfactual successor
no propensity weighting: this experiment estimates factual risk under the logged behavior distribution and reports propensity strata only as support diagnostics
no diagnostic propensity, baseline identity, lifecycle, stage, boss, spell, ECL, RNG, run identity, source, or future fact as a model input
no causal action-effect, long-horizon action-value, HIT-reduction, NMNB, independent-confirmation, or online-execution claim
